job.title: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description: Build and run our order processing APIs. Node.js and TypeScript, PostgreSQL with careful transaction handling, and Redis for caching and queues. You will own schema design, migrations and production debugging. Kubernetes experience is a plus.

resumes.text:
Senior Backend Engineer, Flowmart, 2021 to present
Owned the order service in Node.js and TypeScript serving 4k requests per second.
Designed the PostgreSQL schema and wrote zero downtime migrations for a 200 million row table.
Introduced Redis caching and a job queue, cutting p99 latency from 800ms to 120ms.
On call rotation, led three production incident postmortems.
Earlier: Backend Engineer at Dessa, Express and MySQL.

Backend Engineer, Larkfield, 2020 to present
Built internal REST APIs in Python with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.
Managed Alembic migrations and tuned slow queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
Used Celery and Redis for background jobs.
Some exposure to Node.js on a side project.

Platform Engineer, Northwind, 2019 to present
Ran Kubernetes clusters on AWS with Terraform and Helm.
Built CI pipelines in GitHub Actions for twelve services.
Wrote Go tooling for cluster maintenance.
Supported backend teams with database failover drills.

Frontend Engineer, Peartree, 2021 to present
Built React and TypeScript interfaces with Tailwind CSS.
Improved Lighthouse scores and accessibility across the marketing site.
Design system work in Figma and Storybook.
No server side ownership.

Marketing Manager, Bellhaven, 2018 to present
Ran paid acquisition campaigns across search and social.
Managed a team of four and a six figure annual budget.
Built reporting dashboards in Looker.
Degree in Business Administration.
